conservation_status.note_en: The species-level global category checked for this review is Near Threatened; regional and legal categories may differ.
conservation_status.note_zh: 本次复核确认的物种级全球等级为近危；地区等级和法律地位可能不同。

description.en: Channel Island Fox (Urocyon littoralis) is a omnivore mammal associated with island habitat. It belongs to Canidae; this reviewed summary separates accepted identity and global conservation category from regional claims.
description.zh: 岛屿灰狐（Urocyon littoralis）是与岛屿生境相关的杂食性哺乳动物，属于犬科。本次复核把接受的物种身份和全球保护等级与地区性说法区分开。

anatomy.en: Channel Island Fox is placed in genus Urocyon, family Canidae. Appearance can vary with age, sex, season and locality, so species-level identification should combine several visible characters, location and the accepted scientific name.
anatomy.zh: 岛屿灰狐归入灰狐属、犬科。外形会随年龄、性别、季节和地点变化，因此物种级鉴定应结合多个可见特征、地点和接受学名。

ecology_and_behavior.en: This project classifies the species as omnivore in island habitat. Feeding, activity and social behavior can vary among populations and seasons; details should be tied to an exact-taxon account rather than generalized from one observation.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 本项目把该物种归为岛屿生境中的杂食性动物。取食、活动和社会行为会随种群与季节变化；细节应对应精确分类单元资料，不能从一次观察泛化。

habitat_and_distribution.en: Endemic to six of the Channel Islands off the coast of Southern California, inhabiting coastal scrub, chaparral, and oak woodlands. The existing map is retained for orientation and is explicitly treated as approximate rather than a verified legal or survey boundary.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 特有于南加州海岸外的六个海峡群岛，栖息于沿海灌丛、硬叶灌木林和橡树林中。 现有地图仅为定位参考，并明确作为近似示意，而不是经过核实的法律或调查边界。

habitat.text_en: Endemic to six of the Channel Islands off the coast of Southern California, inhabiting coastal scrub, chaparral, and oak woodlands.
habitat.text_zh: 特有于南加州海岸外的六个海峡群岛，栖息于沿海灌丛、硬叶灌木林和橡树林中。

range_review.comparison_en: The previous center, zoom and every polygon coordinate are retained byte-for-byte. Exact-taxon range evidence supports the broad occurrence context, but no reusable authoritative boundary geometry was established; the polygon remains labelled approximate.
range_review.comparison_zh: 原有中心点、缩放级别和每个多边形坐标均逐字节保留。精确分类单元的分布证据支持大致出现背景，但未取得可复用的权威边界几何，因此多边形继续标为近似范围。

range.authority: GBIF species occurrence and distribution record

content_review.notes: Legacy QC batch 04. GBIF exact identity and global category checked; bilingual templates compared line by line; previous map geometry retained byte-for-byte.

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: Young develop in the mother and depend on milk after birth. Gestation, litter size, weaning and social care are species-specific, so this review does not generalize figures from captivity or another population.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 幼崽在母体内发育，出生后依赖乳汁。妊娠期、每胎数量、断奶和社会照料具有物种特异性，因此本次复核不把圈养或其他种群数字直接泛化。

detail.en: Its body plan is evaluated within Canidae; age, sex and seasonal variation must be separated from species-level traits.
detail.zh: 其身体结构按犬科背景评估；年龄、性别和季节变化必须与物种级特征区分。

detail.en: The omnivore category is a broad guide; exact foods and methods can vary by life stage, season and locality.
detail.zh: 杂食性类别只是宽泛指引；具体食物和方式会随生活阶段、季节及地点变化。

detail.en: Use of island habitat is interpreted from exact-taxon occurrence and range evidence, not from map shape alone.
detail.zh: 对岛屿生境的利用依据精确分类单元的出现与分布证据解释，不能只看地图形状。

ecological_role.en: As a omnivore species in island habitat, it transfers energy through local food webs. Its exact ecological effect depends on abundance, food resources and interactions documented for each population.
ecological_role.zh: 作为岛屿生境中的杂食性物种，它在当地食物网中传递能量。具体生态影响取决于各地种群数量、食物资源和有记录的相互作用。

threats.en: The Near Threatened global category does not remove local risks from habitat change, direct mortality, disturbance, pollution or climate effects.
threats.zh: 近危这一全球等级并不排除生境变化、直接死亡、干扰、污染或气候影响等地方风险。

actions.en: Protect the habitats and ecological processes identified by range authorities, reduce documented direct mortality and update management when monitoring or taxonomy changes.
actions.zh: 应保护分布权威确认的生境和生态过程，减少有记录的直接死亡，并在监测或分类变化时更新管理。

key_features.en: Confirm Channel Island Fox with multiple visible characters, location and an exact taxon-linked record; color or body shape alone may be insufficient.
key_features.zh: 确认岛屿灰狐时，应结合多个可见特征、地点和精确分类单元记录；仅凭颜色或体形可能不足。

similar_species.en: Close relatives and regional look-alikes can share major features. A filename, common name or single trait is not enough for image approval.
similar_species.zh: 近缘种和地区性相似种可能共享主要特征。文件名、俗名或单一特征不足以批准图片。

communication_and_senses.en: Communication and sensory channels are shaped by this species' habitat and class. A specific call, scent signal or sensory claim should be assigned only when the exact-taxon source supports it.
communication_and_senses.zh: 交流与感官通道受该物种生境和类群塑造。只有精确分类单元来源支持时，才能指定具体叫声、气味信号或感官能力。

seasonal_calendar.en: Breeding, movement, molt, dormancy or food use can shift with latitude, rainfall, temperature and resource pulses. A date from one population is not treated as universal.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 繁殖、移动、换羽、休眠或食物利用会随纬度、降雨、温度和资源脉冲变化。某一种群的日期不会被写成普遍规律。

relationship_with_humans.en: Use, conflict, tourism and cultural relationships vary across the range. Safe observation avoids handling, feeding, playback and disturbance of nests, dens or natural behavior.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 利用、冲突、旅游和文化关系因分布区而异。安全观察应避免触摸、投喂、播放声音，以及干扰巢穴、洞穴或自然行为。

evolution.en: Urocyon littoralis is placed in genus Urocyon, family Canidae, order Carnivora. This review follows the accepted species match cited in the taxonomy evidence.
evolution.zh: Urocyon littoralis归入灰狐属、犬科、食肉目。本次复核遵循分类证据中的接受种匹配。

field_signs.en: Tracks, calls, nests, feeding marks, molts or other indirect signs can narrow an identification but usually cannot confirm a species alone. Sensitive or dangerous animals require distance.
field_signs.zh: 足迹、叫声、巢、取食痕迹、蜕皮或其他间接线索可缩小鉴定范围，但通常不能单独确认物种。遇到敏感或危险动物应保持距离。

text.en: The accepted scientific name used in this review is Urocyon littoralis.
text.zh: 本次复核采用的接受学名是Urocyon littoralis。

text.en: Near Threatened is the checked global IUCN category, not a regional legal status.
text.zh: 近危是本次核对的全球IUCN等级，并非地区性法律地位。

text.en: The map retains the previous approximate polygon and does not claim a newly verified boundary.
text.zh: 地图保留原有近似多边形，并不声称这是新核实的边界。

content.en: Young develop in the mother and depend on milk after birth. Gestation, litter size, weaning and social care are species-specific, so this review does not generalize figures from captivity or another population.
content.zh: 幼崽在母体内发育，出生后依赖乳汁。妊娠期、每胎数量、断奶和社会照料具有物种特异性，因此本次复核不把圈养或其他种群数字直接泛化。
